review_summary: Comprehensive independent verification of 9702_m17_42 Question 8 across all 5 leaves (a, b(i), b(ii), b(iii), b(iv)). Question text, trajectory diagram (Fig. 8.1), and 9-mark structure faithfully match the original QP (pages 16-17) and official MS (pages 7-8). Magnetic field definition in (a) accurately captures region of force on moving charges/magnets (2 marks). Fleming's left-hand rule in (b)(i) correctly identifies field direction as out of the page (1 mark). Invariance of particle speed in (b)(ii) is rigorously explained by magnetic force acting perpendicular to velocity resulting in zero work done (2 marks). Circular orbit derivation in (b)(iii) equates magnetic and centripetal forces giving diameter d = 2mv/Bq (2 marks). Semicircular transit time derivation in (b)(iv) demonstrates TF = pi*m/Bq is independent of speed v (2 marks). Hint scaffolding provides >=2 progressive non-revealing hints per leaf, walkthroughs have >=2 complete steps, and all AI rubrics align with curriculum outcomes (9702_t20_m01_o01, 9702_t20_m03_o01, 9702_t20_m03_o05).
